title: Hexus Salts Strawberry Watermelon Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Strawberry Watermelon by Hexus delivers a light and juicy fruit pairing that feels sweet, clean and refreshing. The Strawberry adds a bright burst of summery flavour, while the Watermelon softens the blend with a delicate sweetness and airy texture. It’s a flavour that’s smooth and mellow, ideal for vapers who enjoy subtle fruit blends with a cooling finish. This nicotine salt e-liquid offers a smooth, satisfying throat hit with fast-absorbing nicotine, ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. Its 50VG/50PG ratio makes it suitable for use in pod kits, starter vapes and low-powered MTL devices. Hexus Nic Salts are available in 10mg and 20mg strengths and offer a wide variety of fruity, fizzy and cooling blends made for everyday vaping.
